HediffDef.label: allomantic tin physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been permanently reshaped by tin. {PAWN_possessive} senses operate at a heightened baseline - colors are more vivid, sounds sharper, textures more distinct - but this sensitivity brings with it an agonizing vulnerability to pain.

HediffDef.label: allomantic pewter physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been permanently enhanced by pewter. {PAWN_possessive} muscles are denser and {PAWN_possessive} reflexes sharper than any natural human, but the constant strain on {PAWN_possessive} body has weakened {PAWN_possessive} immune response.

HediffDef.label: allomantic brass physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s constant Soothing has permanently attuned {PAWN_possessive} spirit web to emotional suppression. {PAWN_pronoun} reads and influences others with uncanny ease, but the boundary between {PAWN_possessive} own emotions and those {PAWN_pronoun} manipulates has eroded, leaving {PAWN_objectPronoun} emotionally unstable.

HediffDef.label: allomantic zinc physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s relentless Rioting has permanently reshaped {PAWN_possessive} spirit web. {PAWN_pronoun} can inflame the passions of others with a word, but years of stoking foreign emotions have left {PAWN_possessive} own feelings muted and distant.

HediffDef.label: allomantic copper physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s mind has been fortified by years of maintaining a coppercloud. {PAWN_possessive} thoughts are shielded and {PAWN_possessive} pain tolerance remarkable, but the constant dampening has dimmed {PAWN_possessive} overall mental acuity.

HediffDef.label: allomantic bronze physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s relentless Seeking has permanently sharpened {PAWN_possessive} consciousness. {PAWN_pronoun} can pierce copperclouds and detect Allomantic pulses that would be invisible to lesser Seekers. The rhythms of Investiture hum constantly in {PAWN_possessive} awareness.

HediffDef.label: allomantic steel physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has been subtly reshaped by years of steel Pushing. Faint blue lines flicker permanently at the edges of {PAWN_possessive} vision, revealing nearby metal. The constant outward force has left {PAWN_possessive} frame lighter but more fragile.

HediffDef.label: allomantic iron physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s body has grown denser from years of iron Pulling. {PAWN_possessive} frame carries more weight, grounding {PAWN_objectPronoun} against forces that would move others, and {PAWN_possessive} instinctive reactions in close combat have quickened from constant awareness of metallic objects.

HediffDef.label: allomantic gold physiology
HediffDef.description: Glimpses of {PAWN_nameDef}'s past selves bleed through unbidden, layering memories of lives unlived over {PAWN_possessive} waking mind. This expanded self-awareness has sharpened {PAWN_possessive} consciousness and capacity for learning, but the weight of paths not taken strains {PAWN_possessive} mental stability.

HediffDef.label: allomantic electrum physiology
HediffDef.description: Branching futures flicker constantly before {PAWN_nameDef}'s eyes. Shadows of possible selves dodge, strike, and falter in an endless cascade. The prescience sharpens {PAWN_possessive} combat reflexes, but the overwhelming noise of unrealized timelines fractures {PAWN_possessive} focus on mundane tasks.

HediffDef.label: allomantic atium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web bears the scars of atium's temporal gift. {PAWN_pronoun} moves with an extraordinary prescience in combat, reading opponents' movements before they occur, but the strain of touching Ruin's own metal has aged {PAWN_possessive} body beyond its years.

HediffDef.label: allomantic cadmium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s perception of time has permanently shifted from years of cadmium burning. {PAWN_pronoun} slips into restful states with ease, and {PAWN_possessive} body conserves energy as if still wrapped in a time bubble, but {PAWN_pronoun} struggles to keep pace with the world around {PAWN_objectPronoun}.

HediffDef.label: allomantic bendalloy physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef} exists in a state of perpetual acceleration. {PAWN_possessive} hands move faster than thought and {PAWN_possessive} work is swift, but the metabolic cost is relentless. {PAWN_possessive} body burns through food at an alarming rate and {PAWN_pronoun} can never seem to rest deeply enough.

HediffDef.label: allomantic aluminum physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been scoured smooth by aluminum. The metal's wiping influence has left a permanent mark - {PAWN_possessive} connection to Investiture is muted, granting a natural resistance to its effects but dulling {PAWN_possessive} own Allomantic potential.

HediffDef.label: allomantic duralumin physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web has been warped by repeated duralumin surges. The amplification pathways are permanently widened, allowing for greater bursts of power, but {PAWN_possessive} Allomantic reserves destabilize more readily under the strain.

HediffDef.label: allomantic chromium physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s touch carries a permanent void. Years of leeching have shaped {PAWN_possessive} spirit web into a sink for Investiture, passively dampening the Allomantic abilities of those nearby. The constant outward drain leaves {PAWN_possessive} own reserves less efficient.

HediffDef.label: allomantic nicrosil physiology
HediffDef.description: {PAWN_nameDef}'s spirit web radiates amplification. Years of boosting others have permanently attuned {PAWN_possessive} Investiture to flow outward, passively enhancing the Allomantic abilities of nearby allies. The constant outward flow leaves {PAWN_possessive} own reserves draining faster.
